decode_layout: 16 bytes: input[0..8] = a (u64 LE), input[8..16] = m (u64 LE). Inputs shorter than 16 bytes return an empty Vec (total DECODE). Output: 8 bytes, the u64 result in LE.
entry_called: modinv(a, m) -> u64 (lifted from the original #[jolt::provable] fn; advice tape replaced by direct computation of modinv_naive plus an assert! verification equivalent to check_advice!, both calling modinv_naive)
